home.title: Turkish Sign Language captions for NSosyal video
home.lede: Ses-El reads the spoken Turkish audio in an uploaded video and plays back the TİD signs it recognizes as a picture-in-picture overlay.
home.uploadHelp: Runs on our local backend. No upload? Try the text demo. Source: GitHub.
home.uploadStatusProcessing: Uploading and transcribing, this can take a while for longer videos.
home.uploadStatusErrorSuffix: Make sure the backend server (backend/server.py) is running.
home.card1Body: Matched words and short phrases are substituted and shown one at a time. Continuous, grammatically correct TİD translation isn't yet possible with current research.
home.card2Body: A local Whisper model transcribes the audio and matches it against our vocabulary. No third-party AI service ever sees your video.
home.card3Body: A word missing from our vocabulary is skipped, not guessed at. Tell us if this happens often.

about.title: What Ses-El is, and what it isn't
about.lede: An accessibility layer for video on NSosyal. Mastodon-based platforms have no native video captions, so every upload gets speech-to-text and TİD sign playback as a picture-in-picture overlay.
about.whySection: Why isolated words, not full translation
about.whyBody1: Continuous, grammatically correct spoken-Turkish-to-TİD translation is an open research problem. Sign languages have their own grammar, word order, and non-manual markers (facial expression, posture) that a transcript doesn't capture, and no current system produces reliable sentence-level TİD translation.
about.whyBody2: Ses-El does isolated word and short-phrase substitution against a curated vocabulary instead. Closer to a glossary-based caption than an interpreter.
about.whyLocalBody: Speech-to-text runs on-device with Whisper. Matching is a local lookup, stemmed with Zeyrek for Turkish suffixes. No video or transcript data goes to a third-party AI service, no API key, no per-request billing.
about.limit1Body: Isolated word/phrase substitution. Sentence-level grammar, word order, and non-manual markers aren't modeled.
about.limit2Body: The video pipeline stems Turkish suffixes ("ev" catches "eve", "evden") via Zeyrek. The browser-only text demo still requires exact matches.
about.limit3Body: Intentionally small at launch, expected to grow. See the full list.
about.limit4Body: No guessing when nothing matches, the sign display just goes idle. Intended behavior, not a bug.
about.limit5Body: The sign avatar is a simple animated glyph paired with text gloss, not motion-captured or photorealistic TİD.
about.contextBody: Built for the NSosyal İnovasyon Yarışması, Sosyal Yapay Zeka theme.
